comparison.objective: Sort three waste items into two hinged, lidded bins and close both lids; unrelated to damper commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Lid articulation, semantic sorting, deposit through rim, and closure versus fine mechanical adjustment and cyclic calibration.
comparison.success_condition: Correct containment below rim and both lids closed; any wrong-bin entry permanently zeros. Numerical containment/closure tolerances are not in the record.
comparison.reason: Contact-dependent access and sorting do not test adjustable damping.
